title: Micronucleus quantification from whole-slide haematology images using AI serves as a translatable pharmacodynamic biomarker for DNA damage response inhibitors.
summary: Supervised deep learning quantifies micronuclei in whole-slide blood-smear images; measurements were compared with flow cytometry. The record is limited to the reported cohort, dataset or experiment and does not establish wider clinical or operational benefit.
